derivations.quote: Define the ring map $\Theta$ from $\mathbb C[x_d]/(x_d^r-1)$ to $\mathcal R_r$ by $x_d\mapsto\zeta y$.

Since $\Theta(x_d^k)=\zeta^k y^k$, $\Theta$ is diagonal on the bases $(x_d^k)$ and $(y^k)$, multiplying coefficient $k$ by $\zeta^k\ne0$. It is therefore an isomorphism, with inverse multiplying by $\zeta^{-k}$.
The coefficient of $y^j$ is thus $\zeta^j$ times the cyclic coefficient; untwisting by $\zeta^{-j}$ restores it with the correct sign.
The maps $\iota^{\pm1}$ only regroup scalars, and $D_\pm$ multiplies by numbers of modulus $1$, so all are linear and keep the sup norm.

relations.quote: The twist converts the last cyclic axis into the coordinate of the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](ring-y.md), written $\mathcal R_r$, where $y^r=-1$ instead.
The twist reproduces [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md) on that axis.

symbols.quote: $\iota$ reads each line $(f_{\boldsymbol j,k})_k$ as the polynomial $\sum_k f_{\boldsymbol j,k}y^k$, giving an array of $M$ records in $\mathcal R_r$.

symbols.name: diagonal twist
symbols.meaning: The maps multiplying entry k of each line by zeta^{+-k}.
symbols.quote: Let $(D_\pm f)_{\boldsymbol j,k}=\zeta^{\pm k}f_{\boldsymbol j,k}$ multiply entry $k$ of each line by $\zeta^{\pm k}$.
